instruction: You will start by facing a bedroom. Take a step inside and turn left. Take a step forward and turn left once again. Walk towards the door. Turn right and exit the bedroom. Continue to walk down the hallway and turn left continue to walk down the hallway once again. The railing is on your left and right. Walk all the way to the end of the hallway. Turn right take a step inside the bedroom and turn left. Walk towards the left side of the bed. turn left into the bathroom. Turn left once again. Walk around the shower area. Take a step forward and turn right. Take 2 steps inside the walk in closet and you're done.
